findings.reason: `onServer` makes the host core name plugin MCP servers literally (`spreadsheet-tools`, `ac-tools`, `diagram-tools`) for ten plugin rows that have no spec-operation record. The plugin rows already lived here, so this only deepens existing coupling, and `renderings` is metadata that no runtime code reads. But the repo's plugin/core boundary keeps plugin-entity knowledge out of the core. A later move of these rows (or of their renderings) into the plugins' own contributions would remove that coupling. Merge as is, and note it at the gate. [Orchestrator: promoted to blocking — project rule: host core must not know plugin entities/servers (feedback: plugin↔core boundary). Fix: no plugin server names in core-operations.ts; plugin rows without a spec-operation record carry no renderings, or derive the server from the registered plugin at runtime.]
